NEUTRAL iff both primary metrics are non-inferior within the own null margins (SLU 1.1218, intent 1.0051); a NEUTRAL L1 still enters the SLURP default plan, because it removes a named defect class at no measured cost -- the seven malformed drafts that reached the Planner unflagged and the 2,167 unstructured reviews now carry a declared, receipted disposition.
